title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン
synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world, 14-year-old Shinji Ikari is recruited by his estranged father to pilot a giant mecha called an Evangelion to fight mysterious beings known as Angels. As the battles intensify, Shinji and his fellow pilots struggle with deep psychological trauma, loneliness, and questions about identity and existence.

title: 鋼の錬金術師 BROTHERHOOD
synopsis: After a failed alchemical ritual to resurrect their mother costs Edward his arm and leg and Alphonse his entire body, the Elric brothers set out to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone to restore what they've lost. Their journey uncovers a vast government conspiracy and the dark truth behind alchemy itself.

title: 進撃の巨人
synopsis: Humanity lives within enormous walled cities to protect themselves from the Titans — gigantic humanoid creatures that devour people without reason. When a colossal Titan breaches the outer wall, young Eren Yeager vows to exterminate every Titan and uncover the terrifying secrets of their world.

title: デスノート
synopsis: When honor student Light Yagami discovers a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, he resolves to use it to rid the world of criminals and become the god of a new, perfect world. A brilliant detective known only as L races to unmask the mysterious killer before Light's vision of justice becomes unstoppable.

title: ONE PIECE
synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail to find the legendary One Piece treasure and become King of the Pirates, assembling a crew of uniquely skilled companions along the way. Their epic journey across the seas is filled with fierce rivals, powerful enemies, and the unbreakable bonds of friendship.

title: ナルト
synopsis: Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja shunned by his village for harboring a powerful demon fox, dreams of becoming the greatest ninja — the Hokage — to earn respect and acknowledgment. Through relentless training, fierce battles, and forging deep friendships, he grows from an outcast into a hero who changes the ninja world.

title: ドラゴンボールZ
synopsis: Picking up after Dragon Ball, the story follows an adult Goku defending Earth alongside his son Gohan and allies against increasingly powerful alien and supernatural threats. Each saga raises the stakes as characters push beyond their limits with transformations and battles of cosmic scale.

title: シュタインズ・ゲート
synopsis: Self-proclaimed mad scientist Rintaro Okabe accidentally discovers time travel using a microwave and a phone, allowing him to send messages to the past. As he and his lab members manipulate timelines to save lives, Okabe is pulled into a deadly conspiracy where every choice collapses into tragedy.

title: HUNTER×HUNTER
synopsis: Gon Freecss leaves his island home to become a Hunter — an elite professional licensed to pursue criminals, treasure, and rare beasts — and search for his missing father Ging. Along the way he befriends the calculating Killua and they together face increasingly dangerous and morally complex challenges.

title: カウボーイビバップ
synopsis: In a future where humanity has colonized the solar system, bounty hunter Spike Spiegel and his ragtag crew aboard the spaceship Bebop chase criminals across the stars. Beneath the jazz-soaked adventures lies each crew member's painful, unresolved past slowly catching up with them.

title: ソードアート・オンライン
synopsis: When 10,000 players are trapped inside the virtual reality MMO Sword Art Online with death in-game meaning death in real life, young gamer Kirito must fight his way to the top floor to clear the game and free everyone. Along the way he forms bonds and confronts the blurred line between virtual and real.

title: 鬼滅の刃
synopsis: After his mother is killed by a demon and his younger sister Nezuko is transformed into one, Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure and avenge his family. His journey demands mastery of swordsmanship and breathing techniques as he faces increasingly powerful demonic adversaries.

title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
synopsis: In a world where most people possess superpowers called Quirks, the Quirkless boy Izuku Midoriya inherits the greatest power from the greatest hero and enrolls in a prestigious hero academy. He and his classmates train to become professional heroes while facing real villains who threaten the peace.

title_en: Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World
title: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
synopsis: When Subaru Natsuki is suddenly transported to a fantasy world, he discovers he has the ability to return from death — rewinding time each time he dies. He uses this painful power repeatedly to protect those he loves, but each loop reveals darker truths about the world and himself.

title: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
synopsis: After the war, former child soldier Violet Evergarden begins working as an Auto Memory Doll — a ghostwriter who transcribes people's feelings into letters. As she fulfills requests from clients navigating grief, love, and loss, she slowly learns to understand the meaning of the last words her beloved major ever said to her.

title: 四月は君の嘘
synopsis: Piano prodigy Kousei Arima hasn't been able to hear his own playing since his mother's death, retreating into a colorless world. When the vibrant violinist Kaori Miyazono bursts into his life and pulls him back on stage, their music-filled friendship reawakens his passion even as it is shadowed by an inevitable farewell.

title: CLANNAD
synopsis: High schooler Tomoya Okazaki, drifting aimlessly through life, befriends the quiet and lonely Nagisa Furukawa and helps her revive the school drama club. Their deepening relationship and encounters with other students lead Tomoya toward an emotional reckoning with family, responsibility, and the meaning of happiness.

title: 千と千尋の神隠し
synopsis: Ten-year-old Chihiro stumbles into a magical spirit world and must work in a bathhouse for spirits to survive and find a way to save her parents, who have been transformed into pigs. Her journey through this strange and wondrous world teaches her courage, empathy, and the importance of remembering who she truly is.

title: もののけ姫
synopsis: In feudal Japan, a young man named Ashitaka is cursed after killing a demon boar-god and travels west to find answers, becoming caught in a war between the industrializing Iron Town and the forest gods led by the fierce wolf-raised Princess San. The film refuses easy answers as it explores humanity's destructive relationship with nature.

title: ハウルの動く城
synopsis: A young girl named Sophie is cursed by a witch to live in an old woman's body and finds shelter in the walking castle of the mysterious wizard Howl. As she works to break the curse, she uncovers the secrets of Howl's past and discovers her own courage and worth amid a backdrop of war.

title: ブリーチ
synopsis: High schooler Ichigo Kurosaki gains the powers of a Soul Reaper from a dying girl and takes on her duty of guiding souls to the afterlife and fighting evil spirits. His new role pulls him into a vast spiritual world of competing factions, hidden betrayals, and increasingly powerful enemies.

title_en: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
title: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ
synopsis: Exiled prince Lelouch vi Britannia obtains the power of Geass, which lets him command anyone to obey, and uses it to lead a rebellion against the oppressive Britannian Empire under the masked persona Zero. His strategic genius and ruthless idealism spiral into a tragic conflict of loyalty, sacrifice, and the cost of revolution.

title: 天元突破グレンラガン
synopsis: In a future where humans live underground, young Simon and the boisterous Kamina escape to the surface and join a war against beastmen oppressors using spiral-powered mechs called Gunmen. What begins as a battle for freedom escalates into a cosmic struggle for the very fate of the universe driven by the power of fighting spirit.

title: フェアリーテイル
synopsis: Young wizard Natsu Dragneel and his friends in the chaotic Fairy Tail guild take on magical jobs, battle dark guilds, and go on wild adventures across the kingdom of Fiore. Friendship, loyalty, and the bonds of the guild are tested in ever-escalating conflicts against powerful enemies.

title: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ
synopsis: Genius siblings Sora and Shiro, who are undefeated at every game online, are summoned to a world where all conflict is decided by games. To return home and conquer this world, the duo must use their extraordinary intellect to defeat its god and every nation along the way.

title: オーバーロード
synopsis: When the powerful wizard Ainz Ooal Gown finds himself trapped in the fantasy world of his favorite game with no way home, he decides to take it over using his guild's vast resources and his own overwhelming magical power. The series follows his methodical domination of the world from the perspective of a surprisingly thoughtful undead overlord.

title: メイドインアビス
synopsis: Young adventurer Riko descends into the Abyss — a massive chasm filled with wonders and lethal curses — to find her missing mother, accompanied by a robot boy named Reg who may hold secrets about the Abyss itself. The deeper they go, the more harrowing and irreversible the dangers become.

title: ヴィンランド・サガ
synopsis: Young Thorfinn grows up on the battlefield seeking revenge against the Viking warrior Askeladd, who killed his pacifist father. Set during the Viking Age and English conquest of Scandinavia, the series evolves from a brutal revenge story into a profound meditation on violence, purpose, and what it truly means to be a warrior.

title: モブサイコ100
synopsis: Mob is a middle schooler with overwhelming psychic powers he keeps suppressed to lead a normal life, working under the con-man exorcist Reigen. As Mob's emotional repression reaches a breaking point, the series explores what it means to grow up, find one's identity, and use power with restraint.

title: ワンパンマン
synopsis: Saitama became a hero for fun and trained so hard he can defeat any enemy with a single punch — but invincibility has left him bored and unfulfilled. The series satirizes the superhero genre while following his deadpan adventures in a world full of monsters and overpowered heroes.

title: ブラッククローバー
synopsis: Born without magic in a world where magic is everything, Asta dreams of becoming the Wizard King and trains his body to its limits while seeking a different path to power. Alongside his rival Yuno, he joins the Black Bulls magic knight squad in a kingdom full of hidden corruption and powerful demons.

title: 食戟のソーマ
synopsis: Soma Yukihira enrolls in the elite Totsuki Culinary Academy where students battle in high-stakes food competitions called Shokugeki. Using creativity, technical mastery, and sheer willpower, Soma aims to reach the top of the school and surpass his master chef father.

title: 僕だけがいない街
synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma has a mysterious ability called Revival that sends him back in time moments before tragedies occur — until he is suddenly sent back 18 years to prevent the childhood murder that is connected to a string of killings threatening his present. A tightly woven thriller about memory, responsibility, and saving those who cannot save themselves.

title: とらドラ！
synopsis: When clumsy, hot-tempered Taiga Aisaka and gentle Ryuuji Takasu team up to help each other win over their respective crushes, an unexpected friendship turns into something more. Set against the warm backdrop of high school life, it's a witty and heartfelt romantic comedy about growing up and learning to reach for your own happiness.

title_en: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day
title: あの日見た花の名前を僕達はまだ知らない。
synopsis: Years after their childhood friend Meiko "Menma" Honma died, the members of a friend group have drifted apart — until Menma's ghost appears to Jintan asking him to fulfill her forgotten wish. The series tenderly explores grief, guilt, and the complicated ways people struggle to move on from loss.

title: ダンガンロンパ 希望の学園と絶望の高校生
synopsis: Fifteen high school students wake up in Hope's Peak Academy and are forced to participate in a mutual killing game orchestrated by the sadistic bear Monokuma, where the only way out is to commit murder without being caught. Adapted from the game, it blends courtroom mystery with dark psychological thriller.

title: 東京喰種トーキョーグール
synopsis: College student Ken Kaneki is transformed into a half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, forcing him to straddle two worlds — the human life he cherishes and the violent ghoul society that now claims him. His struggle for identity unfolds in a dark, violent Tokyo where ghouls and humans are locked in a hidden war.

title: ハイキュー!!
synopsis: After being inspired by a volleyball match in middle school, Shoyo Hinata joins his high school team despite his short stature and limited experience. Paired with the brilliant but antisocial setter Kageyama, the two rivals-turned-partners push each other and their team toward the national stage in one of anime's most thrilling sports series.

title: 黒子のバスケ
synopsis: The virtually invisible Tetsuya Kuroko, a former member of the legendary Generation of Miracles basketball team, joins Seirin High School's team with the goal of defeating his former teammates. Working alongside the passionate Taiga Kagami, Kuroko uses his unique misdirection skills to pull upsets against some of basketball's most gifted players.

title: ストレンヂア 無皇刃譚
synopsis: A wandering nameless swordsman takes in a young boy named Kotaro who is being hunted by Chinese warriors seeking a powerful weapon. Set in the final days of the Sengoku period, the film is a masterpiece of fluid sword-fighting animation and quiet storytelling about honor, protection, and redemption.

title: 寄生獣 セイの格率
synopsis: High schooler Shinichi Izumi survives an alien parasite invasion when a Migi — a parasite that bonds with his right hand instead of his brain — saves him. The two must cooperate to survive as other parasites hunting humans see Shinichi as a threat, forcing him to question what it means to be human.

title: 黒執事
synopsis: In Victorian England, young nobleman Ciel Phantomhive forms a Faustian contract with the demon Sebastian Michaelis, who serves as his unflappable butler in exchange for Ciel's soul after he takes his revenge. Together they solve dark supernatural mysteries for the Queen while navigating the shadows of high society.

title: PSYCHO-PASS サイコパス
synopsis: In a future Japan, the Sibyl System measures every citizen's mental state and potential for crime, allowing the Public Safety Bureau to act before crimes occur. Rookie inspector Akane Tsunemori questions the ethics of the system alongside the enigmatic enforcer Shinya Kogami as they pursue a criminal who can outwit the system entirely.

title: Angel Beats!
synopsis: A group of teenagers in an afterlife limbo form a rock band and rebel against the mysterious student council president Angel, refusing to move on and accept their deaths. As their battles unfold, each character confronts the unresolved regrets and traumas of their past lives in a series that balances comedy with emotional catharsis.

title: けいおん！
synopsis: Four high school girls form the Light Music Club almost by accident and spend their days practicing — or avoiding practice — making music together. A gentle and warm slice-of-life series about friendship, passion for music, and the bittersweet awareness of fleeting youth.

title_en: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online
title: ソードアート・オンライン オルタナティブ ガンゲイル・オンライン
synopsis: Karen Kohiruimaki, a tall girl who feels out of place in the real world, finds confidence and freedom in the virtual reality shooter game Gun Gale Online. Her journey to become a top player leads her into a tournament with deadly stakes that blurs the line between the game and real life.

title: ベルセルク
synopsis: Guts, a lone mercenary with a massive sword, joins the Band of the Hawk led by the charismatic Griffith and becomes his greatest warrior. A brutal, medieval dark fantasy that builds to one of anime's most devastating betrayals, exploring the price of ambition, friendship, and destiny.

title: サムライチャンプルー
synopsis: In Edo-period Japan, a rag-tag trio — an unconventional swordsman, a fugitive female assassin, and a wandering vagrant — travel together on a journey tied to the woman's search for a sunflower-scented samurai. Blending hip-hop aesthetics with samurai action, it's a stylish and irreverent road trip through feudal Japan.

title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険
synopsis: Beginning in 1880s England, the Joestar family saga spans generations as each heir battles supernatural evil rooted in a mysterious stone mask. Each arc follows a new JoJo with a distinctive fighting style — from Ripple to Stands — in increasingly flamboyant and creative battles against iconic villains.

title: チェンソーマン
synopsis: Denji, a young man crushed by debt, fuses with his devil dog Pochita to become Chainsaw Man — a hybrid devil hunter working for the government's Public Safety Division. In a brutal world overrun by devils born from human fear, Denji pursues simple dreams while being pulled into increasingly violent and morally chaotic conflicts.
